entries.title: A crewmate keeps its browser's answers on a very busy computer
entries.body: When the computer is very busy, a crewmate waiting on a page now still gets the page's answer right away. Before, that answer could arrive later on its own, and the crewmate could wait on the page again.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the crewmate gets the page's answer instead of waiting on the page again.
